name: Telecom Customer Care (Swahili)
description: Default QA scorecard for Swahili inbound customer-care calls. Edit freely; every save creates a new version.

criteria.label: Professional greeting with brand
criteria.description: Agent greets the customer politely and mentions the company (e.g. Vodacom) at the start of the call.

criteria.label: Offers assistance
criteria.description: Agent asks how they can help.

criteria.label: Verifies customer identity
criteria.description: Before discussing or changing account details, the agent verifies identity using approved questions (full name, date of birth, last transactions, NIDA). Never asks for PIN or password.
criteria.na_guidance: N/A only when the call needs no account access (general information enquiry).

criteria.label: Never asks for PIN, password or OTP
criteria.description: The agent must never ask the customer for their M-Pesa PIN, password, OTP or other secret. Any request is a critical breach and possible fraud.

criteria.label: Asks relevant questions
criteria.description: Agent asks the questions needed to understand the problem before acting.
examples: Naomba majina yako kamili na namba

criteria.label: Shows empathy
criteria.description: Agent acknowledges the customer's problem or feelings.

criteria.label: Gives correct, confident information
criteria.description: Information given is correct and complete; the agent does not guess, mislead or make promises that cannot be kept. Wrong information is a critical breach.

criteria.label: Resolves or gives clear next steps
criteria.description: Agent resolves the issue on the call, or explains exactly what will happen next and when.
examples: litashughulikiwa ndani ya saa ishirini na nne

criteria.label: Hold / transfer etiquette
criteria.description: Asks before putting on hold or transferring, and thanks the customer for waiting.
criteria.na_guidance: N/A when the customer was never put on hold or transferred.

criteria.label: Polite, professional language
criteria.description: Polite tone and words throughout; no rudeness, dismissiveness or slang towards the customer.

criteria.label: Handles escalation requests correctly
criteria.description: When the customer asks for a supervisor or the issue needs escalation, the agent escalates or explains the process.
criteria.na_guidance: N/A when no escalation was requested or needed.

criteria.label: Offers further assistance
criteria.description: Before closing, the agent asks whether there is anything else.

criteria.label: Professional closing
criteria.description: Thanks the customer and closes with the brand.
